authority_rule: The 2024 Kalaignar film-song anthology is a later cross-witness. It may support item identity and an anthology-level attribution to மு. கருணாநிதி, but it never replaces or corrects the Raja Rani booklet's canonical wording.

matches.notes: The film title, ticket-selling performance structure, opening/refrain and long sequence correspond. The later anthology contains wording and lineation variants; those variants are not imported into the Raja Rani source text.
The opening, lyric sequence and film section correspond closely. Source spacing and wording remain edition-specific.

The virutham is the same item by title/opening and full sequence. The two witnesses contain edition-level wording differences, including the booklet's printed `கொடியவனே` versus the later anthology's `கொடியவளே`; neither witness is silently normalized to the other.
Film title, opening/refrain and lyric sequence establish the same item. Raja Rani booklet typography and spelling remain controlling for this work.

The long body and unusual interleaved `வசனம்` / `பாட்டு: ராஜா` structure establish the same song item. The opening is materially variant: the Raja Rani booklet prints `சீலா!...லாலீ!...அது போலீ!...`, while the later anthology prints `வீணா!... வாலி!... அது போலி!...`. The booklet reading is preserved unchanged.

conclusion: Five of the 11 numbered Raja Rani song blocks have a verified item correspondence in the later Kalaignar anthology and therefore receive an `anthology-attributed` Kalaignar authorship disposition. The other six remain unresolved at this gate because the Raja Rani booklet's film-wide lyricist roster supplies no item-level mapping.
